items.description:
The current public preprint is Cognitive Edge Computing: A Comprehensive Survey on Optimizing Large Models and AI Agents for Pervasive Deployment. The two versions share arXiv identifier 2501.03265 and document the manuscript's progression from the optimization triad to cognitive workloads and agents.
The associated journal manuscript is titled Cognitive Edge Computing: A Survey on Optimizing Large Language Models and Autonomous Agents for the Edge. Its current reproducibility artifacts are maintained in this repository. Version-specific BibTeX records are provided under Citation.
